text:
Victor Olofsson is on his second tour in Vegas, after stops in Colorado and Calgary, and eight games in he has scored like a man who never left. Six goals and 10 points, most of them since he came back into the lineup on Nov. 5 after a month out of it, including three points against Utah and a goal from the seat of his pants against Nashville.

Some of this is earned. Vegas has taken 71% of the expected goals (the quality of chances) at five on five with him on the ice, and his line with Ivan Barbashev and Tomas Hertl has been the team's best. Our form check calls the hot streak earned: the team creates far more with him out there than his usual rate.

Some of it is not. Six goals on 3.2 expected means a 25% shooting rate from a player who shot 9% last season, when Evolving-Hockey had him right at replacement level. The finishing will settle. The question for the next month is whether he keeps the spot on that line once it does.
